verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only two bare feature-page headings, "AI & Automation" and "Reporting & Insights". Neither describes AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from the user's data inside the product. "Reporting & Insights" is not described as AI-driven, and "AI & Automation" gives no detail about what it does, so neither documents this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
